title: Clueless Couple Escalated This Situation In Ridiculous Fashion
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On April 14th, 2024. Officers were called to the airport regarding a woman who was causing a major disturbance. The woman refused to listen & comply due to the fact that the employees stating that she cannot bring 3 bags, which is a standard rule when travelling, however she got agitated and started to cause a scene. Her husband who had already boarded came back out and that’s when things started to escalate.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
